September 20.
8. Sunday. Tone 1 [ahz/adz]. Fourth [Sunday]. Forefeast (Barekendan) of the Fast of the Holy Cross. Feast of the Birth of the Holy Mother of God from Anna.
9. Monday. Tone 2 [ahk/ak]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 3 [b]: "Glorified is your name."
15. Sunday. Tone 8 [dk]. Exaltation of the Cross [Khachverats]. For the interim period, see the First Volume up to the Tenth Sunday, keeping the order of this place.
22. Sunday. Tone 7 [dz]. Second [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [dz]: "The First" (Arajin).
23. Monday. Tone 8 [dk]. Fast of the Cross of Varag. Saint Mamas, etc. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [b]: "Without malice" (Anokhakal).
25. Wednesday. Tone 2 [ahk/ak]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] of Fasting Tone 5 [g3]: "Blessed are you, Lord God of our fathers."
29. Sunday. Tone 6 [gk]. Third [Sunday]. Feast of the Holy Cross of Varag. The meat-eating period (utik) is five weeks.

October
6. Sunday. Tone 5 [gz]. Fourth [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [gz]: "By the sign of the cross" (I khachanish).
13. Sunday. Tone 4 [bk]. Fifth [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [bk]: "Christ is risen" (ZKristos yareav), and "Morning" (Aravotean).
20. Sunday. Tone 3 [bz]. Sixth [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [bz]: "To the tomb" (I gerezman), and "They came to the tomb" (Ekin i gerezmann), and "The voice of good tidings" (Dzayn avetavor).
27. Sunday. Tone 2 [ahk/ak]. Seventh [Sunday]. Feast of the Discovery of the Cross.
29. Tuesday. Tone 4 [bk]. Saints Hyperichius [and companions], and Severianus, etc. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [ak]: "O Most High" (Or bardzreald).
30. Wednesday. Tone 5 [gz]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 7 [dz]: "God of our fathers, who in affliction." See to the end in the First Volume, keeping the order of this place.

November
2. Saturday. Tone 8 [dk]. All Saints: ancient and modern, known and unknown.
3. Sunday. Tone 1 [ahz/adz]. Eighth [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [adz]: "With the women" (End kanaysn), and "Ineffable" (Or anchar).
Sunday. Tone 8 [dk]. Ninth [Sunday]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [gk]: "The hosts of angels" (Hreshtakatsn dasq), to the end.
Sunday. Tone 7 [dz]. Tenth [Sunday]. Forefeast (Barekendan) of the Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnakats]. Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [dz]: "You who are above" (Or i verd es), to the end.
Monday. Tone 8 [dk]. Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnakats]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 7 [dz]: "Truly" (Tshmartapes).
Thursday. Tone 3 [bz]. Of the Fast. Feast of the Presentation of the Holy Mother of God of Three Years.
Sunday. Tone 6 [gk]. First [Sunday]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [ak]: "Unoriginate Word" (Anskizbn band). Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [gk]: "Your resurrection" (Ezqo yarutiund), and "Taking" (Areal).
Monday. Tone 7 [dz]. The Holy Virgins Juliana and Vasilouhi, and Abraham and Khoren, Cosmas and Damian, and Astuatsatur the Martyr. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 7 [dz]: "Those who hope" (Yusatsealqn).

December
Sunday. Tone 5 [gz]. Second [Sunday]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 3 [bz]: "You who are King" (Or tagavord es). Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [g3]: "Glorified is your [resurrection]" (Paravoreal e qo).
Monday. Tone 6 [gk]. Genarius, Mercurius, and James and Pravapar.
Tuesday. Tone 7 [dz]. Minas, Hermogenes, Eugraphus, John, and Alexianus. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 5 [g3]: "Holy are you, Lord."
Wednesday. Tone 8 [dk]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] of Fasting Tone 8 [dk]: "Blessed Lord God of the fathers."
Sunday. Tone 4 [bk]. Third [Sunday]. Forefeast (Barekendan) of the Fast of Saint James. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 4 [bk]: "He who [made] his servant." Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [bk]: "The women anticipated" (Kankhetsin kanayqn).
Monday. Tone 5 [gz]. Fast. Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin from Anna.
Sunday. Tone 3 [bz]. Fourth [Sunday]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 5 [g3]: "Glorified Son." Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [bz]: "Today they rejoiced" (Aysor zuarchatsan).
Sunday. Tone 2 [ak]. Fifth [Sunday]. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 6 [gk]: "Pre-eternal" (Nakhayavitean). Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [ak]: "Risen" (Yarutsyal), and "Wonderful" (Sqancheli), and "Wondrous" (Hrashali).
Monday. Tone 3 [bz]. David the Prophet, and James the Apostle.
Sunday. Tone 1 [ahz/adz]. Sixth [Sunday]. Forefeast (Barekendan) of the Fast of the Nativity. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 5 [g3]: "Only-begotten Son." Resurrection Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [adz]: "Awesome sight" (Sokali tesil), to the end.
